subject.title: feat(dashboard): workspace document + control plane (plugin backend) [1/3]

question: Should OpenClaw accept a default-on bundled dashboard control-plane plugin after the storage/provenance/security fixes land, or should this remain off by default or outside core for now?
rationale: This is not a mechanical bug fix: it adds persistent state, mutating gateway/tool APIs, approval/provenance state, startup activation, and dependency metadata, so automation cannot decide the product and security boundary.

options.title: Require bundled-plugin hardening first
options.body: Keep the PR open but require SQLite-backed state, monotonic undo, trusted actor derivation, dependency authorization, and explicit product/security approval before merge.

options.title: Accept the current direction
options.body: A maintainer/security owner can explicitly approve the default-on bundled control plane and dependency graph change once they accept the upgrade and audit tradeoffs.

options.title: Defer outside core
options.body: Pause or close the bundled plugin path and ask for an off-by-default external plugin or ClawHub package until the dashboard direction is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Require bundled-plugin hardening first
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open but require SQLite-backed state, monotonic undo, trusted actor derivation, dependency authorization, and explicit product/security approval before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the strongest current-main owner signal for plugin storage and SDK boundary work that this decision depends on.
